description: The chart on the left represents the distribution of responses to a test question, categorized into four types: Atomic Skill Fail, Correct, Reason Error, and Question Misunderstood. The chart shows that 68.0% of the responses were Correct, 12.0% were Reason Error, 8.0% were Question Misunderstood, and 12.0% were Atomic Skill Fail. The chart on the right shows the distribution of responses to a different test question, categorized into three types: Question Misunderstood, Reason Error, and Correct. The chart shows that 55.0% of the responses were Correct, 21.0% were Reason Error, 14.0% were Question Misunderstood, and 10.0% were Question Misunderstood. Both charts are pie charts with no legends, percentage labels inside the slices, and no visually emphasized slices. The segments in both charts appear to be ordered in a descending manner based on their proportions.
